steps.what: Read the proposed advertising and verify the fundraising objectives and donor restrictions
Compare the proposed promotion against the actual fundraising compatibility checklist
Judge donor fit, competing asks, reputational risks and required changes
Write and check the actual internal evaluation and its reasons

tasks.design: Configure the {DOCS} evaluation document with recurring fundraising criteria and fields for the facts the manager checks in s1. It removes repeated checklist construction while leaving the comparison, judgement and actual evaluation writing with the manager.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same evaluation criteria can be reconstructed in each review.
tasks.enabler_now: A native document template can retain recurring criteria without inferring donor compatibility.
tasks.still_hard: The manager must recognise conflicting promises and unsuitable messages.
tasks.human_edge: Judgement about donor trust and the organisation's mission.
tasks.altitude: Reuse evaluation structure without automating the decision.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native document templates retain recurring comparison criteria.

assumptions: Shares are provisional hypotheses, not measured baselines.
An internal written evaluation already exists and is read by campaign planners; no additional record is introduced.
Existing author saves remain part of writing and have no approval gate.
research_questions: How often do planners rebuild rather than reuse the comparison criteria?

already_counted.description: Check source facts in s1, adapt the comparison in s2 and retain all judgement and evaluation writing.

incremental.description: Amortised upkeep of the compatibility checklist.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100. Reusing recurring criteria removes 25*0.12=3 hours less 0.5 upkeep, net 2.5. Cautious case: a new beneficiary group needs bespoke criteria and only 0.7 hours of standard restriction headings are reusable, leaving 0.2 net; substantive comparison stays manual.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify the brochure brief, approved facts, images, permissions and fundraising claims
Draft the actual brochure copy and place it into the publication layout

loop.purpose: Draft brochure prose within the checked publication brief
loop.input: Manager-verified facts, permitted imagery, brief and layout fields
loop.output: Draft copy with each factual claim linked to its input
loop.check: Manager checks every claim, amount, beneficiary portrayal, omitted qualification and layout overflow against the sources
loop.stop: Missing source or two failed revisions returns the prose to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Use native layout and fixed approved wording first; only variable narrative needs a bounded drafting loop

steps.what: Edit promotional publications and brochures for truth, donor suitability, accessibility and visual quality

tasks.design: Use a native {OTHER} publication layout and fixed approved text before a bounded loop drafts variable brochure copy from manager-checked facts. OTHER denotes desktop publishing software; final editing includes repair and the ordinary author save, while publishing is a separate task outside this design-and-edit scope.
tasks.previous_blocker: Variable narrative must be written alongside repetitive publication structure.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded draft can propose text without deciding whether claims or imagery are acceptable.
tasks.still_hard: Emotional framing must remain accurate and respectful to beneficiaries.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides how the organisation represents its cause to donors.
tasks.altitude: Assist publication drafting while retaining final editorial work.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a bounded language-model draft can be constrained to supplied publication facts but requires editorial checking.

assumptions: Shares and drafting reduction are unmeasured hypotheses.
No source extraction or approved claim arrives free: the manager prepares them in s1.
No automated publication, mailing or print order is included.
research_questions: Does source-checking and repair leave a net reduction in initial copywriting?

already_counted.description: Check draft claims in s2 and repair rejected copy and layout in s3.

incremental.description: Amortised prompt, claim-reference and layout regression checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100. Initial drafting removes 35*0.25=8.75 hours less 1 upkeep, net 7.75. Cautious case: a sensitive beneficiary story needs almost complete manual rewriting, leaving only 1.2 hours of routine introductory copy removed and 0.2 net; the extra rewrite consumes the rest of the nominal drafting benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review the agency's actual progress, mandate, costs and unresolved fundraising issues
Discuss priorities, resolve disagreements and direct the external agency's fundraising activities
Write the existing agency instruction with the agreed owners, scope and dates
Check and approve the final instruction and its named agency recipients
Send the approved agency instruction to the approved recipients

tasks.design: Keep agency direction in the actual discussion and reuse a native {DOCS} instruction layout for the written follow-up already used by the agency. Approve the completed version and recipients before its separate send; the ordinary draft save requires no approval and yields no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recurring written instructions can repeatedly need the same scope and ownership headings.
tasks.enabler_now: A document template supplies only those headings and recurring organisation details.
tasks.still_hard: Resolving agency performance problems and changing priorities remain interpersonal work.
tasks.human_edge: Accountability for direction, relationships and the agency mandate.
tasks.altitude: A small improvement to an existing written instruction.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: document templates can reuse stable instruction headings.

assumptions: This is the branch with an existing written agency instruction, read to carry out the agreed work; no new trailing record is invented.
Shares are hypotheses; oral-only direction has no template saving.
Instructions stay within the manager's existing mandate and do not place a new contract or spend commitment.
research_questions: Are repeated headings currently re-entered in the actual agency follow-up?

already_counted.description: Write the substantive instruction in s3 and check its final version and recipients in s4.

approvals.approved_version: s4 final instruction version and exact agency recipients; any edit voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100. Reused headings remove 14*0.05=0.7 hours less 0.2 upkeep, net 0.5. Cautious case: a bespoke agency recovery instruction reuses only 0.25 hours of organisation details, leaving 0.05 net; discussion, content and send remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Produce and distribute fundraising films and operate their library

steps.what: Plan and produce the actual fundraising film with its participants and permitted material
outputs: recorded fundraising footage and checked production context

steps.what: Edit picture, sound and captions into the final fundraising film
inputs: recorded fundraising footage and checked production context

steps.what: Enter and maintain the film library's actual titles, versions, permissions and asset links
outputs: updated film library metadata and asset reference

steps.what: Review the final film, rights, captions and distribution destinations and approve release
inputs: updated film library metadata and asset reference
outputs: approved film version, access limits and destinations

steps.what: Release the approved film version only to its approved distribution destinations
inputs: approved film version, access limits and destinations
outputs: distributed film within the approved limits

tasks.design: Configure reusable {OTHER} film-library metadata fields and carry forward checked unchanged production details when creating a new version. OTHER denotes video-editing and media-library software; the manager still creates and verifies metadata, edits the film and approves the exact final release separately from its distribution.
tasks.previous_blocker: Library versions can require repeated entry of unchanged title and production context.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue duplication can reuse stable fields while flagging version-specific permissions for review.
tasks.still_hard: Production, truthful editing and rights decisions cannot be inferred from a filename.
tasks.human_edge: The manager protects participants and decides what the audience should see.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repeated media-library metadata entry without automating film production or release.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: media-library forms can duplicate stable metadata when creating a new asset version.

assumptions: Illustrative shares are not measured production times.
The existing library is actually maintained for finding films and controlling permitted distribution.
All new captions, rights and participant permissions are checked manually; no automatic transcription or consent extraction is assumed.
Existing release interaction is fully retained and ordinary catalogue saves yield no saving.
research_questions: Which metadata is genuinely unchanged across film versions?

already_counted.description: Verify and repair duplicated metadata in s3 and review final content and rights in s4.

incremental.description: Amortised review of metadata carry-forward rules.

approvals.approved_version: s4 final film version, named destinations and access limits; any content or destination edit voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100. Reuse removes 20*0.20=4 metadata re-entry hours less 0.6 upkeep, net 3.4. Cautious case: a new film with different participants and licences permits only 0.8 hours of stable organisation metadata to carry forward, leaving 0.2 net; new rights and descriptive fields stay manual.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Use small document and library improvements while retaining donor judgement and agency direction.
skills_to_grow: Trace publication claims to source facts
Separate editorial work from distribution approval
role.ambitious_version: A fundraising manager uses reliable publication and media records while preserving personal accountability for the cause and its representation.
